ns2:section.sectionText: In this James Scholar Honors section, students will explore and examine media practices and brand experiences related to tourism and travel for international destinations or "place brands." The class will develop knowledge and skills related to how destinations abroad use media, attractions, events, people, history, government, businesses and culture to tell their brand stories and create brand identities in the context of a global tourism marketplace. Experiential learning and immersive activities abroad in Amsterdam, Munich, and surrounding areas will allow students to gain cultural competencies and global perspectives related to international travel and tourism. Course requires travel to Amsterdam and Munich for approximately 8 days in May, 2019. An application which was due on October 11 was required for consideration. The fee range is currently $2000-2200 and will be communicated to students at the time of course acceptance.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to James Scholars Program students.
